## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `<type>/<short-description>`, cut from `main`
- [ ] Commits follow `type(scope): summary`
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] New env vars are in `.env.example` and documented
- [ ] No secrets, build output or unrelated changes
- [ ] UI changes checked at 360px and desktop, in light and dark themes, with screenshots
